messages:
Ava: Quick ask — we need a small spotprobe for the launch story. Can runtime do a quick sanity + provenance check on the benchmark samples we'll cite? Need: 1) sample origins (source file + cohort tag), 2) warmup/coldstart heatmap, 3) quantized vs fp16 smoke diffs. Target: 48h.

Liam: @Ava ok — rough scope understood. Can you drop the sample manifest and the exact payloads? also which model/config pairs to test (e.g., gpt-*-base quantized-8 vs fp16)?

Ava: dropping manifest now — attaching short list: cohort A (live search queries), cohort B (ui copy prompts), cohort C (long-context support). Payloads: 100 random per cohort, seed=42. Prefer MPT-30B-quant-8 and MPT-30B-fp16 for parity. Link to manifest: https://internal/redwood/launch/manifests/spotprobe-042.json

Sofia: Ava sending sample provenance note — I'll add per-sample origin and ingestion hash to the manifest. One ask: runtime needs the exact --max-tokens and warmup pattern used in the published bench (we used 32 tokens, 3 warmup queries per host).

Liam: perfect. For reproducibility we need: payload JSONL, run script, and the env (CUDA/driver) snapshot. If you want an automated rerun I can queue a quick smoke job — takes ~2-3h per model variant. Confirm priority = high and I'll spin it up.

Ava: priority high. pls include traces for the first 10 requests per cohort and token-level latency for warmup vs steady-state. Also we want KV-cache behavior notes for long-context cohort C.

Liam: ack. I'll run:
```
./run_spotprobe.sh --manifest spotprobe-042.json --models mpt-30b-fp16,mpt-30b-quant8 --seed 42 --output /tmp/spotprobe-1769999001
```
Will push artifacts to the run bucket and ping this thread.

trace-bot: New trace bundle uploaded by @Liam: s3://redwood-runs/spotprobe-1769999001/traces.tar.gz

Sofia: uploaded provenance.csv to the run bucket and added ingestion hashes. I also flagged 4 samples that were synthetic/augmented — marked in the manifest as source=augmented.

Liam: quick note — quantized warmup shows slightly higher first-token latency on cohort C (long context), but steady-state throughput matches within 3%. I'll post the heatmap and a tiny summary in the run artifacts.

Ava: awesome, thanks. Can you email the artifacts to the marketing distro once the run completes? We'll need one slide and one quoted stat (p95 latency delta) for comms.

Liam: will do. ETA artifacts + short summary: ~5h from now.

Ava: thanks team :pray:
